about: I am a third-year Computer Science and Engineering student at Kumaraguru College of Technology, currently focusing on AI, Machine Learning and Data Science. I am interested in understanding how technology can be applied to real-world problems and turned into useful solutions. My interests include artificial intelligence, data-driven applications, practical problem-solving and building technology that can have a useful impact. I have worked on projects involving healthcare AI, textile sorting, phishing email detection and smart classroom applications.

projects.name: AI Healthcare Treatment Response Recommendation
projects.alt: Placeholder concept visual for the AI healthcare treatment response recommendation project
projects.description: Full-stack ML web application predicting multi-treatment response feasibility across 6 therapy types.
projects.challenge: Comparing treatment response across multiple therapy types usually means consulting several separate models and reports, which slows down clinical decision support.
projects.approach: Trained and evaluated 4 ML models — Gradient Boosting, Logistic Regression, MLP Neural Network, and Random Forest — comparing individual accuracy metrics. Supports single and multi-treatment modes across Chemotherapy, Immunotherapy, and Surgical Interventions.
projects.outcome: A Flask-based web application with automated PDF clinical report exports via REST APIs, giving comparative model analytics in one place.

projects.name: Smart Food Delivery System
projects.alt: Placeholder concept visual for the smart food delivery system project
projects.description: End-to-end full-stack web platform with authentication, menu management, and a conversational AI ordering assistant.
projects.challenge: Food ordering platforms need to combine secure accounts, live menu management, and fast answers to common customer questions without added friction.
projects.approach: Engineered secure session authentication and relational schema management in MySQL, alongside dynamic menu management and an intelligent chatbot interface.
projects.outcome: A working platform where the chatbot handles instant menu recommendations, order status queries, and FAQ resolution end to end.

projects.name: Logistics & Route Optimization System
projects.alt: Placeholder concept visual for the logistics and route optimization project
projects.description: Fleet-aware route navigation system combining live traffic and GPS telemetry to prevent delivery delays.
projects.challenge: Vehicle clustering and unexpected congestion are common causes of delivery delays and rising fuel costs in fleet logistics.
projects.approach: Integrated continuous GPS streams with real-time traffic data and implemented a configurable Dynamic Congestion Blocking algorithm that automatically isolates overloaded road segments.
projects.outcome: A route optimization system that reduces vehicle clustering, cuts fuel costs, and improves delivery SLA performance.
